API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIPartner IntegrationsGet Aws Account
Get Aws Account
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/publicCloudInfo

Retrieves the list of AWS accounts with metadata. To learn more, see About Amazon Web Services Accounts.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
page
int32

Specifies the page offset.

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size.

Default value: 250
Responses
​
default

Default response. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

The unique ID of the AWS account.

name
string

The name of the AWS account. The name must be non-null, non-empty, unique, and 128 characters or fewer in length.

accountDetails
object
accountGroups
object[]
cloudType
string

The cloud type. The default and mandatory value is AWS.

Possible values: [AWS, AZURE, GCP]

externalId
string

A unique external ID for the AWS account.

Note:

The ID must be unique across different organizations. Two organizations cannot use the same external ID.
Multiple accounts can share the same external ID within the same organization.
The ID must be between 2 and 128 characters long.
The ID can include letters, numbers, and the following symbols: +, =, ,, ., @ ,:, /, and -.

lastModTime
int32

The date and time when the AWS account was last modified.

lastModUser
object
lastSyncTime
int32

The last time the AWS account was synced.

permissionStatus

Indicates whether the provided credentials (external ID and AWS role name) have permission to access the AWS account.

regionStatus
object[]
supportedRegions
object[]
]
